_comment: Binds scenario -> diagram -> env -> thresholds so an acquisition scenario
cannot be run against a *-sim-* build by accident. Previously this pairing
lived only in a comment inside each .scenario.yaml ('Pair with a diagram
that sets hx711 missedReadyEvery > 0'), which meant a green result could
be produced from a build that never reads DT/SCK.
NOTE on rates: diagram attr 'actualSps' (94.22) drives cadence ONLY in the
real-HX711 harness envs. The *-sim-* envs ignore it entirely and use the
build flag WMBP_SIM_HX711_HZ instead. Two rate knobs exist; each env reads

A row with lintOnly:true is built and its diagram linted, but the simulator is not run. Use it for model-fidelity targets that cannot produce serial - it keeps compile coverage without a bogus runtime FAIL.

runs.name: clean-94hz
runs.why: Baseline cadence against a clean 94.22 SPS source.

runs.name: dout-missed-ready
runs.why: missedReadyEvery=97 (~1 dropped edge/sec at 94 Hz). Proves the timeout+level-poll recovery path: an edge-only design would stall permanently here.

runs.name: midstream-tare-loaded
runs.why: 27.5 g applied at 5s, then a serial tare. Exercises the owner-queued tare path under load.

runs.name: late-usb-enable
runs.why: USB stream enabled mid-run; acquisition must already be steady.

runs.name: tinys3d-feature-proxy
runs.why: TinyS3[D] firmware-feature proxy running on Wokwi's XIAO ESP32-S3 board. Exercises HX711 acquisition plus MAX17048 and LIS2DW12 I2C model wiring; it is not a TinyS3[D] hardware model, and TinyS3-only RGB, USB-sense pin fidelity, RF antenna switching, and board-variant behavior are outside this runtime row.

runs.name: hx711-pulse-trace
runs.why: Captures DT/SCK to VCD via wokwi-logic-analyzer, then asserts 25 clocks per conversion and no spurious DOUT-edge servicing. Replaces the 'optional logic-analyzer gate' with an automated one - note it proves pulse COUNT/ORDER, not real T3 width (WMBP_HX711_PULSE_SETTLE_US=3 widens pulses in the harness).

runs.name: float32-flow-ramp
runs.why: set-control sweeps applied weight at 2/4/8/14 g/s. Exercises the Float32 coherence gates on-device without a real pour.

runs.name: tinys3d-devkitc-feature-proxy
runs.why: TinyS3[D] firmware-feature proxy matched to Wokwi's DevKitC Arduino variant. Uses the builder-confirmed external pins except for DevKitC-only LCD_CS GPIO39 and USB-sense GPIO47 substitutes for unavailable physical GPIO34/GPIO33. The exact map is retained by the custom Tiny board and production build.

runs.name: tinys3d-lis-identity
runs.why: Checks LIS2DW12 identity, bounded soft reset, all four XYZ scale ranges, routed data-ready, and continued HX711 output.

runs.name: tinys3d-motion-sequence
runs.why: Compact daily gate for quiet, vibration, knock, cup-placement impact, and double-tap diagnostics while HX711 acquisition continues.

runs.name: tinys3d-motion-quiet
runs.why: Feeds the deterministic quiet waveform into the diagnostic-only motion analyzer.

runs.name: tinys3d-motion-vibration
runs.why: Feeds sustained vibration while checking motion activity and HX711 cadence.

runs.name: tinys3d-motion-knock
runs.why: Checks bounded impact and tap-candidate diagnostics from the deterministic knock waveform.

runs.name: tinys3d-motion-cup
runs.why: Checks impact plus ring-down activity from the deterministic cup-placement waveform.

runs.name: tinys3d-motion-double-tap
runs.why: Checks diagnostic double-tap candidates without connecting them to tare behavior.

runs.name: tinys3d-max17048-discharge
runs.why: Checks MAX17048 signed CRATE direction for discharge.

runs.name: tinys3d-max17048-sequence
runs.why: Compact daily gate for signed discharge and charge rates plus low-SOC alert behavior. Missing-at-boot remains a separate row.

runs.name: tinys3d-max17048-charge
runs.why: Checks MAX17048 signed CRATE direction for charging.

runs.name: tinys3d-max17048-alert
runs.why: Drives low SOC and waits for the modeled latched MAX17048 alert path.

runs.name: tinys3d-max17048-missing
runs.why: Takes the MAX17048 model offline before firmware discovery and checks the explicit missing-gauge backend.

runs.name: tinys3d-devkitc-integration
runs.why: Single DevKitC one-way UART0 gate for display checkpoints, touch page selection, LIS/MAX traffic, full-frame SPI updates, and HX711 cadence.

runs.name: tinys3d-devkitc-boot-no-color
runs.why: DevKitC boot A/B control: full custom-chip diagram with color UI construction and execution disabled.

runs.name: tinys3d-devkitc-boot-color
runs.why: DevKitC boot A/B treatment: same diagram and chips as the control, with color UI enabled.

runs.name: tinys3d-devkitc-boot-no-peripherals
runs.why: DevKitC boot isolation control: deterministic Wokwi/HX711 runtime retained while the complete Tiny peripheral coordinator is compiled out.

runs.name: tinys3d-devkitc-serial-sentinel
runs.why: Six-second board-only discriminator for DevKitC flash/PSRAM application boot and explicit one-way UART0 serial capture, independent of the full firmware and all peripheral models.

runs.name: tinys3d-display-checkpoints
runs.why: Presents splash, weight, flow, QR, status, and Pour Over canvases to the pixel-rendering Waveshare model and records deterministic framebuffer checksums.

runs.name: tinys3d-touch-pages
runs.why: Injects an AXS5106L touch point and verifies rotation-aware page selection.

runs.name: tinys3d-i2c-spi-cadence
runs.why: Measures HX711 stream continuity while 100 Hz LIS2DW12 reads, MAX17048 diagnostics, touch polling, and one-Hz full-frame SPI updates are active.
